item.title: enforce_groom_limits removes new items in file order — high-priority items after cap fills get discarded
item.intent: When the groom cap is reached, the highest-priority new items must be kept and the lowest-priority ones removed, so a must item is never discarded to make room for a should item.
item.description: enforce_groom_limits processes new items in the order they appear in the JSON file. If the grooming agent adds 12 items (cap=10) and the last 2 happen to be 'must' while earlier items are 'should', the 'must' items are removed because the cap was already filled. The cap enforcement should sort new items by priority rank and remove the lowest-priority ones when the limit is exceeded.
steps: In enforce_groom_limits, after collecting new_ids_with_prio, sort the list by priority rank (must=0, should=1, could=2, future=3) before applying the max_items cap
Keep the priority-threshold check first (remove items below min_priority regardless), then apply the sorted cap so high-priority items are always preferred
Test: add 12 items where items 11-12 are 'must' and items 1-10 are 'should' — confirm 'must' items are kept and 2 'should' items are removed
Run shellcheck — confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: When cap is exceeded, must items are always kept over should items regardless of insertion order
Priority threshold still rejects items below GROOM_MIN_PRIORITY
Existing items (in snapshot) are never removed
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
